newsitem.title: PERU: SOCCER-ANTHEM BAN AT PERU-ECUADOR CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANTHEM BAN AT PERU-ECUADOR CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Peru and Ecuador will not play their national anthems before next month's World Cup qualifier because of fears that the music might inflame nationalist feeling between the South American rivals, an official said.
Peru and Ecuador fought a brief war over an Amazon border dispute in early 1995. Several dozen soldiers died and hundreds were wounded.

"You must understand the moment we are going through and that it is not advisable to play the national anthems for obvious reasons," Peruvian Soccer Federation president Nicolas Delfino said on Monday night.
"I would like to ask the press not to encourage fans to sing either nation's anthem."
Peru and Ecuador meet in Lima on April 2.
